dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, high-contrast outer perimeters that transition into diffuse, lighter gray-white interior zones. The perimeters are non-uniform in thickness, showing scalloped or slightly jagged edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, dark, solid-colored sub-circular blobs situated primarily in the interstitial spaces between the larger annuli. These blobs lack internal gradients and show high core pixel concentration.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an asymmetrical obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of smaller annuli along the upper dorsal ridge forms a semi-linear chain trajectory.
